title: Typography: CSAIL Ebony
slide_intent: Teach readers how to create emphasis within a single family. A change of weight, style or numeral form can clarify a passage without introducing another face.
strategic_value: The lab can maintain its typographic identity in everyday documents while giving long headings, lists and body text distinct roles.
demonstration: A blue specimen panel demonstrates heavy and thin headings, italic emphasis, oldstyle figures, three weight pairs, paragraph alignment and bullets.
practical_value: Use the side-by-side weight pairs to choose a restrained two-weight hierarchy. Refer to the list and number examples for smaller text.

content_islands.name: Usage introduction
content_islands.spec: Introduce the practical settings in the narrow left rail.

content_islands.name: Heading and figure specimens
content_islands.spec: Start the right panel with heavy and thin title lines, italic emphasis and an example of oldstyle numerals.

content_islands.name: Weight pairs and text setting
content_islands.spec: Stack three weight pairs on shared baselines. Finish with a short paragraph and bullet examples to show settings beyond headlines.
